item.text: {"analysis":"The trial crashed after 1.77 allocated GPU-seconds and produced no validation score. The supplied traceback reports only that train.py exited with status 1; it does not reveal the underlying exception. The optional threadpoolctl fallback and training_error.log diagnostics therefore remain unverified fixes. Inspecting the trial’s captured training exception is necessary before attributing the failure to a dependency, data loading, or model fitting issue.","code_summary":"CPU-based sparse local ridge regression with separate models for all four categories. Binary training histories form the user-item matrix. Each target item selects up to 128 neighbors by cosine co-occurrence similarity, excludes itself, and fits coefficients using a local covariance eigendecomposition. Ridge values 10, 100, and 1000 are selected per category using validation HR@10, with NDCG breaking ties. Inference sums learned coefficients over unique history items. The predictor writer embeds the same inference class and routes by dataset_name. Artifacts are written beneath the trial’s working directory; data comes from GAGC_DATA_DIR."}
